column3: Serving with the articles has an active plural subject rather than a passive construction.
Aaron’s sons are identified by a pronoun rather than his repeated name.
“By the mouth of the LORD” retains the body image.
The number of names is explicitly lifted.
The count explicitly mentions those registered.
Taking is repeated, and “for the skull” retains the body image.
